name: AR Plane
author: sampstrong
description:
As the time runs down, your goal is to fly through the golden rings to rack up as many points as possible in this epic space themed mini game! Watch out for the rockets and keep an eye out for blue and green pickups that can give you special abilities and extra time. 

Use the left and right arrow keys to control the player.

This is V1.0. Future releases plan to have an augmented reality game mode where you can place the game in the world around you for a more immersive experience!
